products.name: ET7022
products.desc: Designed to bring circuit-level visibility to distribution boards, the Branch Circuit Power Meter tracks active power, energy, and power factor across individual single and three-phase branches — giving electrical teams a granular breakdown of consumption that a single main meter cannot provide. Its DIN rail form factor, Modbus RS485 communication, and wide 85-270V auxiliary supply make it a straightforward retrofit into existing panels for data centres, commercial buildings, and industrial facilities focused on load profiling and energy cost allocation.
products.dims: 185 x 110 x 30 (WXHXD)

products.name: ET1641
products.desc: The DC Meter monitors up to four independent current channels alongside a DC voltage input across a 20-60V range — self-powered directly from the rectifier it measures, eliminating the need for a separate auxiliary supply. With 1% FSR accuracy, derived power and energy readings up to 65kW and 100,000 kWh, it is purpose-built for battery systems, solar installations, telecom rectifiers, and EV charging infrastructure where precise DC energy accountability is non-negotiable

products.name: ET4602
products.desc: Where the AC Meter (INV 4602) earns its place is in dual-source energy environments — separately tracking kWh consumption from both grid (EB) and diesel generator (DG) supplies across all three phases, giving operators a clear split of utility versus backup power costs. With 2000VAC-isolated RS485 communication, phase-wise voltage and current breakdowns, and a wide 45-65Hz frequency tolerance, it serves energy auditors, building managers, and industrial plants looking to bring accountability and precision to their power monitoring without deploying multiple devices.
